follow-up time: Weekly until 36 weeks gestation, then biweekly
outcome: Fetal cardiac and peripheral circulation parameters (including pulmonary artery and aortic peak systolic velocity, umbilical artery resistance index, etc.)
cohort: 22 pregnant women with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) and 44 healthy controls.
finding: While there were no significant differences in most fetal cardiac and peripheral circulation parameters between pregnant women with ICP and healthy controls, women with ICP had increased risks of preterm delivery, neonatal unit admission, and meconium-stained amniotic fluid.
